The passage does not say this is the shortest possible start to a list of blessings.
The statement that Bethel and Shiloh are Bible places needs a reference outside this passage.
Only Meribah follows the word waters. Massah does not.

The statement that Ephraim and Manasseh are Joseph's sons needs a reference outside this passage.
